an8.77:1.1: tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi
an8.77:1.3: āvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
an8.77:2.1: aṭṭhime āvuso puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an8.77:2.3: idhāvuso bhikkhuno pavivittassa viharato nirāyattavuttino icchā uppajjati lābhāya
an8.77:2.5: tassa uṭṭhahato ghaṭato vāyamato lābhāya lābho nuppajjati
an8.77:2.6: so tena alābhena socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷī kandati sammohaṃ āpajjati
an8.77:2.7: ayaṃ vuccatāvuso bhikkhu iccho viharati lābhāya uṭṭhahati ghaṭati vāyamati lābhāya na ca lābhī soci ca paridevi ca cuto ca saddhammā.
